hero.title: Studies and Education
hero.intro: Our Studies and Education program is dedicated to fostering intellectual growth and spiritual development through comprehensive educational initiatives. We believe that education is a powerful tool for transformation and empowerment.
hero.mission: Our goal is to cultivate the mindset of pioneers - individuals who think critically, act compassionately, and lead with wisdom. We provide access to quality education, theological training, and leadership development programs that equip people to make positive changes in their communities and beyond.
hero.approach: Through partnerships with educational institutions, scholarship programs, and innovative learning approaches, we ensure that education is accessible to all, regardless of their background or circumstances.

background.title: Background
background.content: In a world where the foundations of faith are being shaken from childhood, children's ministry has become an urgent necessity. Given our service's constant focus on the new generation, we believe that empowering Sunday school leaders and children's ministry leaders with the right tools and necessary knowledge is the way to raise children who grow in firm faith and healthy spiritual life.

academy.title: Empowering a New Generation
academy.subtitle: A Christian academy for children's ministry leaders in collaboration with the Spiritual Center for Training and Studies

goal.title: The Goal
goal.subtitle: Empowering the New Generation
goal.content: Launch a one-year diploma program targeting leaders aged 18 to 40, providing them with comprehensive training in the theological and spiritual foundation of ministry, principles of child-rearing, child psychology, impactful leadership, and the use of creative methods in teaching.

vision.title: The Vision
vision.content: Establish a Christian academy that provides spiritual, practical, and skill-based training for leaders who serve children within the church, and empowers them to teach and serve in effective, innovative, and biblically fruitful ways.
